description: Initial scoring model skeleton. Weights, baselines, and thresholds below are placeholders for design/demo purposes and have not been calibrated against real product data.

categoryRuleCatalog.description: Starting sub-scores come from mattressTypeBaselines for the mattress's construction type, before any profile-specific adjustment.
Firmness rating falls inside the sleeper's comfort band; a small bonus is applied to the support sub-score.
Firmness rating falls outside the sleeper's comfort band; support is penalized proportionally to how many points outside the band it sits.
Firmness rating is softer than the comfort band, which typically improves pressure relief; a small bonus is applied.
Firmness rating is firmer than the comfort band, which typically reduces pressure relief; a penalty proportional to the overage is applied.
Mattress has a cooling cover; a bonus is applied to the heat & airflow sub-score.
Mattress is all-foam with no cooling cover; a penalty is applied to the heat & airflow sub-score, since foam alone tends to retain more heat.
Sleeper reports high motion sensitivity (shares the bed, easily woken) and the mattress type is on the low-isolation list; a penalty is applied to motion isolation.
Mattress has a reinforced perimeter; a bonus is applied to the edge support sub-score.
Top foam density is below the durability threshold and the sleeper's weight is at or above the high-weight threshold; a penalty is applied for elevated long-term sag risk.
Top foam density comfortably exceeds the durability threshold; a small bonus is applied.

riskFlagRules.description: Fires when the mattress's firmness rating falls outside the firmness comfort band resolved for the sleeper's position and weight band.
riskFlagRules.mitigation: Consider a firmer or softer variant in the same line, or add a mattress topper to move the feel into your comfort band.

riskFlagRules.description: Fires when the sleeper reports sleeping hot and the computed heat sub-score is at or below the heat retention threshold.
riskFlagRules.mitigation: Look for gel-infused foam, a hybrid coil layer, or an added cooling cover/topper if you tend to sleep warm.

riskFlagRules.description: Fires when the mattress has no reinforced perimeter and the computed edge sub-score is below the edge support threshold.
riskFlagRules.mitigation: Fine for sleepers who stay centered; worth weighing a model with reinforced perimeter coils if you sit on the edge often.

riskFlagRules.description: Fires when top foam density is below the durability density threshold and the sleeper's weight is at or above the high-weight threshold.
riskFlagRules.mitigation: Check the warranty's sag-depth threshold and prioritize using the full in-home trial period to catch early sagging.
